Rud-Tekma is a fruit native to the jungles and rainforests of southern Endor. It grows in hot, humid climates but remains very hard to find.

The fruit is eaten directly. For one hour, it provides about +20 to spell-casting rolls at the cost of −20 to melee combat and maneuvers. Directed Spells may also veer toward the nearest target. Repeated doses carry a risk of habituation.
